facts.text: Through the FHU Promise, eligible incoming students who qualify for a Federal Pell Grant, have at least a 21 ACT (or 1060 SAT), and maintain a 3.0 high school GPA pay or owe no more than $6,250 per semester for tuition, food, and housing.

sources.title: FHU Promise - Freed-Hardeman University
sources.quote: Our student financial service program, FHU Promise, ensures that each student pays or owes at most $6,250 per semester for tuition, food and housing.
